'''Narcisse Ngoy''' (born 13 July 2004)<ref>{{cite web |title=# 94 Narcisse Ngoy |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-u20-eurobasket-2024/teams/france/368262-narcisse-ngoy |website=FIBA |access-date=7 April 2026}}</ref> is a French [[college basketball]] player for the [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn Tigers]] of the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC). He previously played for [[Chorale Roanne Basket]], [[Rouen Metropole Basket]], and [[Poitiers Basket 86]] in France. On June 24, 2026, Ngoy was selected with the 57th overall pick by the [[Atlanta Hawks]] in the [[2026 NBA draft]], he was then traded to the [[Los Angeles Clippers]].

==Career==
Ngoy played for various teams in France. For [[Poitiers Basket 86]], he averaged 10.6 points per game by March 2026 of the 2025–26 season, alongside 11.5 rebounds and 2.5 blocks.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Hughes |first1=Mary Kate |title=Auburn Tigers basketball signs 7-foot French professional Narcisse Ngoy |url=https://flywareagle.com/auburn-tigers-basketball-signs-7-foot-french-professional-narcisse-ngoy |website=Fly War Eagle |access-date=7 April 2026 |date=March 31, 2026}}</ref> Playing as a center, he was described as a dominant figure in the paint by the [[Ligue nationale de basket]].<ref>{{cite web |title=The new generation of French basketball shines in Betclic Elite and Elite 2. |url=https://lnb.fr/en/news/la-nouvelle-generation-du-basket-francais-sillustre-en-betclic-elite-et-en-elite-2 |website=Ligue nationale de basket |access-date=7 April 2026 |date=16 March 2026}}</ref> In his last season with them, he led the team in rebounds and blocks per game.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Kennedy |first1=Scott |title=Auburn Tigers Sign Elite 7-Foot French Big Man |url=https://www.si.com/college/auburn/news/auburn-tigers-sign-elite-7-foot-french-big-man-narcisse-ngoy |website=Auburn Tigers on SI |publisher=Sports Illustrated |access-date=7 April 2026 |date=March 31, 2026}}</ref>
===Auburn===
Ngoy signed to play for Auburn on March 31, 2026.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Cole |first1=Adam |title=Auburn basketball signs French 7-footer for 2026-27 season |url=https://www.montgomeryadvertiser.com/story/sports/college/auburn/2026/03/31/narcisse-ngoy-auburn-basketball/89350578007/ |website=Montgomery Advertiser |access-date=7 April 2026 |date=March 31, 2026}}</ref> Head coach [[Steven Pearl]] said, "he's a high-upside young man who brings toughness, physicality, and a team-first mindset to everything he does."<ref>{{cite web |last1=Rauterkus |first1=Peter |title=Auburn basketball signs 7-foot center from France |url=https://www.al.com/auburnbasketball/2026/03/auburn-basketball-signs-7-foot-center-from-france.html |website=AL.com |access-date=7 April 2026 |date=April 2, 2026}}</ref>

===NBA===
On June 24, 2026, Ngoy was drafted by the [[Atlanta Hawks]] with the 57th overall pick in the [[2026 NBA draft]] and traded to the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] shortly after.<ref>{{cite web |title=Atlanta Hawks Acquire the Draft Rights to Henri Veesaar |url=https://www.nba.com/hawks/news/atlanta-hawks-acquire-the-draft-rights-to-henri-veesaar |website=NBA.com |access-date=June 24, 2026 |date=June 24, 2026}}</ref> However, he has re-affirmed his commitment to play at Auburn in 2026–27.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/25445576-clippers-draft-pick-narcisse-ngoy-decides-return-auburn-instead-playing-lac|title=Clippers Draft Pick Narcisse Ngoy Decides to Return to Auburn Instead of Playing for LAC|first=Doric|last= Sam|date=June 25, 2026|accessdate=June 25, 2026}}</ref>

==International career==
Ngoy represented France at the [[2024 FIBA U20 EuroBasket]] competition, averaging 1.5 points per game and playing in every game but the final.<ref>{{cite web |title=Narcisse Ngoy |url=https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/285753/narcisse-ngoy#anchor-international |website=Proballers |access-date=7 April 2026}}</ref>
